title: Resume gateway-owned package work after deploy restart
description: Verify late shutdown results cannot settle a pipeline step, then restart an isolated gateway during package preparation and finalization with the node up or restarting. Scripted workers only; no live farm, model turn or publication.

late-shutdown-result.intent: Keep late success and refusal running for restart recovery while real package errors still fail closed.

complete-node-restart.intent: A real node rejects a held COMPLETE request during command closeout; the step resumes on the replacement node without a manual replay.

package-restart.intent: Non-regression: isolated package preparation and finalization still match their baseline across gateway and node restarts.
